prompt: In a vibrant anime style, the scene unfolds at a busy airport gate where ten distinct figures occupy the space. To their right, a businessman in glasses checks his silver wristwatch impatiently. Near him, a small brown dog sits calmly on the floor, wearing a red collar. Behind the dog, a traveler in a backpack leans against a pillar, eyes closed in sleep. On the far right, an elderly woman in a floral coat hands a boarding pass to a uniformed agent standing near the gate entrance. The agent, wearing a navy cap, takes the pass with a polite smile. Above them all, a ceiling fan spins slowly. There is no snow visible through the windows. There is no food being eaten by any of the passengers.
